paragraphs.en: 总结：CorrFlow提出自校正流匹配框架，通过轻量化修正器复用隐状态预测速度残差，在图像与视频生成上显著提升质量。 Flow-matching models generate samples through iterative velocity predictions, but typically do not revisit these predictions using the intermediate representations that produced them. We introduce CorrFlow, a self-correcting flow-matching framework that reuses this information through a lightweight refiner. Under rectified-flow interpolation, the error of the one-step clean prediction equals the realized velocity residual scaled by the noise level. Motivated by this identity, the refiner learns to predict residual corrections from the base model's clean prediction, conditioning, noise level and hidden states from the same forward pass. The correction is added to the base velocity before each sampling update, so subsequent predictions are made from the corrected state. This requires no additional base-model evaluations and only one lightweight refiner evaluation per step. Our theoretical analyses establish conditions under which feature reuse outperforms raw-input affine predictors and refiner training achieves greater residual-risk reduction than continued base-model training under a matched training compute budget. Experiments on class-conditional image generation, text-to-video generation and image-to-video generation show consistent improvements over the corresponding base models, including gains in visual quality and physical consistency. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/corrflow-project
paragraphs.zh: 总结：CorrFlow提出自校正流匹配框架，通过轻量化修正器复用隐状态预测速度残差，在图像与视频生成上显著提升质量。流匹配模型通过迭代的速度预测来生成样本，但通常不会利用产生这些预测的中间表示来重新审视这些预测。 我们提出CorrFlow，一种自校正流匹配框架，它通过一个轻量化修正器复用这些信息。 在整流流插值下，单步干净预测的误差等于已实现的速度残差按噪声水平缩放后的结果。 受这一恒等式启发，修正器学习从基础模型的干净预测、条件、噪声水平以及同一次前向传播得到的隐状态中预测残差修正。 该修正在每次采样更新前被加到基础速度上，因此后续预测都基于修正后的状态进行。 这不需要额外的基础模型评估，每步只需一次轻量化修正器评估。 我们的理论分析确立了在何种条件下特征复用优于原始输入的仿射预测器，以及在匹配训练计算预算下，修正器训练比继续训练基础模型能实现更大的残差风险降低。 在类条件图像生成、文本生成视频和图像生成视频上的实验表明，相较相应的基模型取得了一致的改进，包括在视觉质量和物理一致性方面的提升。 项目主页：https://fogradio.github.io/corrflow-project

sents.en: 总结：CorrFlow提出自校正流匹配框架，通过轻量化修正器复用隐状态预测速度残差，在图像与视频生成上显著提升质量。 Flow-matching models generate samples through iterative velocity predictions, but typically do not revisit these predictions using the intermediate representations that produced them.
sents.zh: 总结：CorrFlow提出自校正流匹配框架，通过轻量化修正器复用隐状态预测速度残差，在图像与视频生成上显著提升质量。流匹配模型通过迭代的速度预测来生成样本，但通常不会利用产生这些预测的中间表示来重新审视这些预测。

sents.en: We introduce CorrFlow, a self-correcting flow-matching framework that reuses this information through a lightweight refiner.
sents.zh: 我们提出CorrFlow，一种自校正流匹配框架，它通过一个轻量化修正器复用这些信息。

sents.en: Under rectified-flow interpolation, the error of the one-step clean prediction equals the realized velocity residual scaled by the noise level.
sents.zh: 在整流流插值下，单步干净预测的误差等于已实现的速度残差按噪声水平缩放后的结果。

sents.en: Motivated by this identity, the refiner learns to predict residual corrections from the base model's clean prediction, conditioning, noise level and hidden states from the same forward pass.
sents.zh: 受这一恒等式启发，修正器学习从基础模型的干净预测、条件、噪声水平以及同一次前向传播得到的隐状态中预测残差修正。

sents.en: The correction is added to the base velocity before each sampling update, so subsequent predictions are made from the corrected state.
sents.zh: 该修正在每次采样更新前被加到基础速度上，因此后续预测都基于修正后的状态进行。

sents.en: This requires no additional base-model evaluations and only one lightweight refiner evaluation per step.
sents.zh: 这不需要额外的基础模型评估，每步只需一次轻量化修正器评估。

sents.en: Our theoretical analyses establish conditions under which feature reuse outperforms raw-input affine predictors and refiner training achieves greater residual-risk reduction than continued base-model training under a matched training compute budget.
sents.zh: 我们的理论分析确立了在何种条件下特征复用优于原始输入的仿射预测器，以及在匹配训练计算预算下，修正器训练比继续训练基础模型能实现更大的残差风险降低。

sents.en: Experiments on class-conditional image generation, text-to-video generation and image-to-video generation show consistent improvements over the corresponding base models, including gains in visual quality and physical consistency.
sents.zh: 在类条件图像生成、文本生成视频和图像生成视频上的实验表明，相较相应的基模型取得了一致的改进，包括在视觉质量和物理一致性方面的提升。
